verdict.rationale: Snoozing and follow-up reminders are a fair question for an email client like Zero, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions snooze, reminders, or resurfacing unreplied threads. The documented capabilities stop at labels, archive, read/unread, search and AI drafting, which are adjacent triage features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
